title: Minimum allowable thickness.
officialText:
For design thicknesses 1 inch (25 mm) or greater, the minimum allowable
individual thickness shall be the design thickness minus 1/4 inch (6.4 mm). For design thicknesses less than 1 inch (25 mm), the
minimum allowable individual thickness shall be the design thickness minus 25 percent. Thickness shall be determined in
accordance with ASTM E 605. Samples of the sprayed fire-resistant materials shall be selected in accordance with Sections
1704.11.4.2 and 1704.11.4.3.
